name: Xinjiang Tianye Co., Ltd.
summary: Xinjiang Tianye Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells chemical products in China and internationally. The company offers chemical products, including industrial sodium hydroxide, polyvinyl chloride resin, ethylene glycol, butanediol, suspension method general-purpose polyvinyl chloride resin, micro-suspension method for polyvinyl chloride paste resin, sodium hypochlorite solution, hydrochloric and caustic acid, suspension process polyvinyl chloride specialty resin, matte polyvinyl chloride resin, n-butanol, solid mercury catalyst, and light calcium carbonate.
